tools.name: droptrack_list_tracks
tools.description: List tracks in the current company with play, download, and view counts. Returns paginated results and, when the library is empty, guidance for requesting an audio file or Spotify/SoundCloud link.

tools.name: droptrack_list_playlists
tools.description: List all playlists in the current company with track counts.

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_analyss
tools.description: Read the saved report for the exact track/version without creating another analysis. Ground feedback in returned audio evidence. tools.name: droptrack_browse_submission_opportunities
tools.description: Browse the public submission directory for labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators. These are general directory results, not personalized track recommendations. Featured placement is separate from genre fit; review current requirements and payment before submitting.

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities
tools.description: Find submission opportunities using a track genre, stored tags, and account genre preferences. Explain the actual match basis; no genre inputs means general directory results. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: droptrack_get_track_analysis, droptrack_browse_submission_opportunities, droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities · Private data: droptrack_list_tracks · Public sink: droptrack_get_track_analysis, droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: droptrack_get_track_analysis, droptrack_browse_submission_opportunities, droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities · Private data: droptrack_list_tracks · Public sink: droptrack_get_track_analysis, droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
